info.title: FuelLog API
info.description: Backend with identity, vehicles, fuel entries, full-tank consumption cycles and summaries. No frontend. Editing, deletion, exports, password recovery and complete account management are planned. All protected queries enforce ownership. Decimal values use strings. Consumption is null with a reason when unavailable.

get.summary: Read owned vehicle purchase totals and full-tank consumption
get.description: Purchases are filtered by occurrence date. Consumption aggregates valid cycles closed in the interval, including purchases before the interval. The latest valid cycle is global and carries explicit dates. Replenishment cost per km is an operational approximation.

get.description: Initial full tank volume is excluded; intermediate purchases and the closing full tank are included. History gaps and zero distance produce null consumption with a reason. Items are filtered by closure date. currentUnavailableReason describes the global current history segment.
